questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which structure connects the fetus to the placenta?
questions.hint: It contains an artery and a vein.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Name the fluid that surrounds and cushions the fetus in the uterus.
questions.hint: It is held inside the amniotic sac.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: State one function of the amniotic fluid.
options: It supplies oxygen to the fetus
It protects the fetus from mechanical shock
It digests food for the fetus
questions.answer: It protects the fetus from mechanical shock
questions.hint: Think of how a liquid absorbs bumps.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which substance passes from the mother's blood to the fetus across the placenta?
questions.hint: The fetus needs it for respiration.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which substance passes from the fetus to the mother across the placenta?
questions.hint: It is a waste product made in the liver.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Why are the blood of the mother and fetus kept separate in the placenta?
options: To allow red blood cells to cross
To prevent high maternal blood pressure damaging the fetus and to avoid mixing of blood groups
questions.answer: To prevent high maternal blood pressure damaging the fetus and to avoid mixing of blood groups
questions.hint: Consider pressure and blood groups.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: By what process does oxygen move from maternal blood into fetal blood in the placenta?
questions.hint: Movement down a concentration gradient.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which feature increases the surface area of the placenta for exchange?
questions.hint: Finger-like projections into the uterus wall.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which of these can cross the placenta and harm the fetus?
questions.hint: It comes from smoking.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Name the virus that can cross the placenta during pregnancy and damage the developing eyes, ears and heart of the fetus.
questions.hint: Girls are often vaccinated against it before adulthood.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: What is antenatal care?
options: Care of a baby after birth
Medical care given to a pregnant woman before birth
questions.answer: Medical care given to a pregnant woman before birth
questions.hint: 'Ante' means before.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which vessel in the umbilical cord carries oxygenated blood to the fetus?
questions.hint: In the cord, the vessel taking blood towards the fetus is named the opposite way to the adult pattern.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Antibodies crossing the placenta from the mother give the baby which type of immunity?
questions.hint: The baby did not make the antibodies itself.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Explain why a pregnant woman is advised not to smoke.
questions.hint: Think about carbon monoxide, nicotine and what crosses the placenta.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Describe how the structure of the placenta is adapted for efficient exchange of substances.
questions.hint: Mention surface area, distance and blood supply.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Explain why alcohol drunk by a pregnant woman can affect the fetus.
questions.hint: Consider molecule size and how it crosses the placenta.

bss.topic: Estrutura geológica e recursos minerais do Brasil

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual é a estrutura geológica mais antiga, formada por rochas cristalinas (magmáticas e metamórficas)?
questions.hint: É associada a minerais metálicos.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Como se chama a estrutura formada pelo acúmulo de sedimentos em áreas rebaixadas da crosta?
questions.hint: Os sedimentos se depositam em camadas.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Que tipo de recurso está mais associado às bacias sedimentares?
questions.hint: Forma-se a partir de matéria orgânica soterrada.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Que tipo de recurso está mais associado aos escudos cristalinos?
questions.hint: É um minério metálico.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Por que o Brasil não possui dobramentos modernos (como os Andes)?
options: Porque está no centro da Placa Sul-Americana, longe dos limites de placas convergentes
questions.answer: Porque está no centro da Placa Sul-Americana, longe dos limites de placas convergentes
questions.hint: Pense na posição do Brasil em relação às placas tectônicas.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual estado brasileiro dá nome ao Quadrilátero Ferrífero?
questions.hint: Fica na região Sudeste.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: A Serra dos Carajás é uma grande área de extração de minério de ferro em qual estado?
questions.hint: Fica na região Norte.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Onde está a maior parte do petróleo extraído no Brasil hoje?
options: na camada pré-sal, no litoral do Sudeste
questions.answer: na camada pré-sal, no litoral do Sudeste
questions.hint: É uma exploração marítima em grande profundidade.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual destas é uma grande bacia sedimentar brasileira?
questions.hint: Tem o nome de um grande rio do Sul e Sudeste.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: O Maciço do Urucum, em Mato Grosso do Sul, é conhecido pela extração de quais minérios?
questions.hint: Dois minérios metálicos usados na siderurgia.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual minério é a principal matéria-prima do alumínio?
questions.hint: O Pará tem grandes jazidas dele.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Por que o carvão mineral brasileiro é considerado de baixa qualidade?
options: Tem baixo poder calorífico e muitas impurezas, como cinzas e enxofre
Só existe no fundo do mar
questions.answer: Tem baixo poder calorífico e muitas impurezas, como cinzas e enxofre
questions.hint: Pense em quanto calor ele gera ao queimar.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Explique a relação entre a estrutura geológica e os recursos minerais encontrados no Brasil.
questions.hint: Compare escudos cristalinos com bacias sedimentares.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Cite um impacto ambiental da mineração e uma forma de reduzi-lo.
questions.hint: Pense em barragens de rejeitos, desmatamento ou água.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Por que a descoberta do pré-sal foi importante para a economia brasileira? Apresente um argumento a favor e um desafio.
questions.hint: Considere produção, exportação, custos e meio ambiente.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Em que região brasileira fica a maior parte das reservas de carvão mineral do país?
questions.hint: É a região de clima mais frio do Brasil, onde ficam as bacias sedimentares mais antigas com carvão.

bus.topic: Working capital and improving cash flow

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Working capital is calculated as:
questions.hint: It is about short-term items only.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: A business has current assets of $45,000 and current liabilities of $30,000. Calculate its working capital in dollars.
questions.hint: Subtract the liabilities from the assets.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Which of these is a current asset?
questions.hint: It will be turned into cash within a year.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Which of these is a current liability?
questions.hint: Money owed to suppliers.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: What term describes buying goods from a supplier now and paying for them later?
questions.hint: Suppliers give the business time to pay.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: What is debt factoring?
options: Selling trade receivables to a specialist company for immediate cash
questions.answer: Selling trade receivables to a specialist company for immediate cash
questions.hint: The business gets less than the full amount but gets it now.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Why is working capital important for a business?
options: It shows total profit for the year
It allows the business to pay its day-to-day costs
It is the value of the business's buildings
questions.answer: It allows the business to pay its day-to-day costs
questions.hint: Think about paying wages and suppliers this month.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Which action would improve a business's cash flow?
options: Asking customers to pay more quickly
questions.answer: Asking customers to pay more quickly
questions.hint: Bring cash in sooner.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: What is a likely problem of having too much working capital?
options: The business cannot pay its bills
Money is tied up and not used productively
questions.answer: Money is tied up and not used productively
questions.hint: Idle cash or inventory could be invested elsewhere.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Current assets are $80,000 and working capital is $25,000. Calculate current liabilities in dollars.
questions.hint: Rearrange the working capital formula.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Which is a disadvantage of debt factoring?
options: It takes many months to receive cash
The business receives less than the full value of what customers owe
It must be repaid with interest over ten years
questions.answer: The business receives less than the full value of what customers owe
questions.hint: The factoring company charges a fee.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Which of these improves cash flow by reducing cash outflows?
options: Leasing equipment instead of buying it
Increasing the credit period for customers
Buying raw materials in bulk with cash
Paying suppliers early to get a discount
questions.answer: Leasing equipment instead of buying it
questions.hint: Spread the payments out.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: What is the name of a short-term facility that lets a business spend more than it has in its bank account?
questions.hint: It is flexible but interest can be high.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Explain one advantage and one disadvantage of a business reducing its inventory levels to improve cash flow.
questions.hint: Think about cash tied up versus risk of running out.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: A small bakery is struggling to pay its suppliers. Suggest two ways it could improve its cash flow and explain each.
questions.hint: Consider cash inflows and cash outflows separately.

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: Discuss whether a profitable business can still fail because of poor cash flow.
questions.hint: Profit and cash are not the same; think about timing.
